text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun,
marking the start of the Senior Year battles.

There are plenty of big races just around the corner,
like the Tenno Sho (Spring) and Takarazuka Kinen, but—
choice_data_list: (I hope they give it their all this year too...!)

text_block_list.text:
Holding those thoughts close to my chest,
I began preparing for training, but...
Gold Ship was nowhere to be seen.

Having no other choice, I decided to search around the academy.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ticket-zo. I've been thinking.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"They might be students now, but the time will come when they head out into the world.
So I gotta ask: what will they need when that time comes?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's needed?
Hmmm... I wonder what?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —To put it simply, it's all about real-world social skills!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What?!
WORKFORCE SKILLSSS?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Seamlessly blending into society,
and taking sharp, efficient action—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That is the power needed to avoid causing trouble
for the public—the power of a working adult!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see...!!!!
Not causing trouble for others is super important, huh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So today, I'd like to test our professional workplace etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's go, quick and slick!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Follow me!!

For now, I decided
to chase after Gold Ship and the others...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look... it's the station.
That place, you see, is the battlefield of working adults.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A-A battlefield!? What do you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Listen up, mind your train manners. No matter what kind of trouble arises, you must never cause a fuss on the train.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even if your stomach's rumbling,
or you suddenly feel like whistling,
you bear it in silence. That's what being a working adult is about.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I seeee!!
Being a working adult is so tough...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today is the dry run for that. Let's prove to them
that we can blend right into society, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So with that, let's see who can stay quiet longer on the train! It's on!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...!
It looks tough, but let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer!
You've been sneaking peeks at me this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I need you to witness this showdown!
Keep your eyes peeled and see for yourself
which one of us fits into society better!

And so, I ended up watching
Gold Ship and the others' battle to the end.
(Click-clack, click-clack...)
15 seconds after the start—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...F-Focus your mind...
...Crab, shrimp, squid, octopus...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Grrr... I'm a working adult, a working adult...!
30 seconds later—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Scallops, sea bream, mantis shrimp, dolphins—
Wait, shoot... Dolphins are mammals, aren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"A proper working adult never panics,
never rushes, never makes a scene, and never flinches...!!"
45 seconds later—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For a self-proclaimed ocean expert like me to go and lump seafood and mammals together...!
Ngagagagagi-i-i-t...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Must not move, must not move...!!
Nggghhhhh...!!
—And, one minute later.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOAAAAAHHH...!!!!!!
I'm at my absolute liiiiimit...!!!!!!

The moment we arrived at the next station,
I rushed the two of them off the train!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *wheeze*... *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I couldn't breathe...!!
I thought it was the end for meeeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, that incident really made me realize from the bottom of my heart how important breathing actually is...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If there was one more thing I learned—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Dolphins are mammals...!!
That's the one thing you can't get wrong!!"

Before a victor could even be decided,
the match came to an abrupt end...

—It's a draw with Winning Ticket!
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　(To be continued)

That night—Gold Ship once again
had a strange dream.
"O golden ship sleeping at the bottom of the sea..."

"‘Steadily drawing nearer...
To that glorious, uncharted territory—’"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nnh... What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right.
It's probably that thing, the Eden one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Man, every time I hear it,
that voice just has this strange way of sticking in my ear..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I don't know if nostalgic is the right word, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Gold Ship-san.
You are quite late waking up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mornin'... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(I see, it feels similar...
To this feeling I have with McQueen...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The scent of the tatami mats at Grandpa's house...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?!
Who is what, now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(No... but it feels subtly
different from McQueen's...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(If anything, it smells kind of like...
socks after a long day of work...)
